d: TIDEBOUND #3 — The Crimson Tide. The call comes at midnight: the Coral Steps needs Brenlmira. Starring Brenlmira (Zecott Dovex), Thallith (Cormir Minor), Sylnethus (Kacott Tawick), Ulrineia (Sefell Roven). Harbor kids and old sailors bound by tide-oaths guard the sea-roads between Gullrest and the drowned places.
